review_authority.scope: Approve semantic definitions with explicit conditions; no runtime activation, binding, implementation or numerical calibration approval.

rule_decisions.reason: The explicit Revenue/PAT/EPS name matches the three core measurements and preserves true five-year mathematics.
conditions: Six consecutive comparable FULL_YEAR observations per metric, spanning five fiscal intervals; five observations never suffice.
Positive endpoints are required for this CAGR convention; invalid-domain signed values remain descriptive, never zero-filled or N/A.
Source-qualified EBITDA stays optional; V1 four-component verdicts and thresholds are not transferred.

rule_decisions.reason: Independent standard ROE preserves return-efficiency evidence while qualified ROCE cannot be inferred from a missing or issuer-specific numerator.
conditions: Annual PAT and exact beginning/end equity must have compatible attribution, scope and periods; mean equity positive; no ending-only fallback.
Missing ROCE is policy/data unavailable, never N/A for absence alone; ready ROE does not establish complete ROCE/ROE coverage.
Financial-sector branches remain blocked; reported ROE/ROCE require formula-matched corroboration contracts.

rule_decisions.reason: Debt/equity core, net debt and interest coverage answer different questions; explicit completeness prevents debt/equity alone implying financial health.
conditions: Debt/equity alone yields CORE_READY_OPTIONAL_INCOMPLETE when net debt or coverage is unavailable; full_rule_ready=false and economic_verdict=null.
Exact debt definition and same-end positive equity remain prerequisites; ready observations do not invent unavailable debt/cash/interest facts.
Net debt and interest coverage retain their own policy/data states; adverse or conflicting optional evidence stays visible.
DSCR is a separate measure and can never replace interest coverage.

rule_decisions.reason: Complete Revenue/PAT/EPS comparisons preserve quarterly-results purpose; optional EBITDA is not a universal core prerequisite.
conditions: Five consecutive QUARTER_ONLY observations establish exact q/q-1 and q/q-4 comparisons; YTD and nearest-quarter substitutions are forbidden.
All three positive-domain YoY/QoQ pairs are needed for core completeness; one surviving component remains partial.
Missing optional EBITDA reduces optional coverage only; no zero-fill or score renormalization.

rule_decisions.reason: The explicit Net Profit Core name describes PAT/revenue and discloses the change from V1 operating/gross wording.
conditions: PAT / Revenue means NET_PROFIT_MARGIN only, with finite signed PAT, positive revenue, exact period/scope/attribution and compatible units.
Net margin is a fraction; YoY percentage-point change is 100 * (margin_q - margin_q_minus_4). Five consecutive quarter-only observations remain the contract.
Operating margin, gross margin and issuer EBITDA margin are distinct optional/future contexts with their own source-qualified numerator definitions.
No V1 0.02 margin classification threshold or operating-efficiency conclusion is inherited.

rule_decisions.reason: Independent qualified multiples preserve valid evidence without manufacturing a complete valuation view or a favourable score.
conditions: P/E uses its exact annual EPS/PIT price definition; price session and per-share basis remain explicit.
P/B requires approved book/share/price alignment; EV/EBITDA requires an approved EV bridge and source-qualified positive denominator; both remain gated where unavailable.
Forward P/E requires governed forward EPS; PEG requires governed positive growth/horizon/unit definitions. No forecast or growth fill.
Missing EV/EBITDA never erases P/E or independently valid P/B; financial-sector cells remain policy blocked.
NOT_READY retains underlying INSUFFICIENT_DATA or EVIDENCE_CONFLICTED reasons; no optional-component reweighting.

entity_policy_decision.standard_branch_meaning: Semantic branch approved conditionally; not proof of sufficient evidence, implemented evaluator or runtime readiness.
entity_policy_decision.classification_contract: Reuse exact canonical issuer/security mapping and PIT-visible regulator/statutory/exchange/taxonomy evidence; verify effective times and source fingerprints.

approval_clarification.scope: Clarifies the already-proposed core/coverage distinction; no formula, component role, required input, threshold or canonical ID changes.
approval_clarification.meaning: READY_STANDARD_BRANCH/READY_ENTITY_SPECIFIC_BRANCH are core-only aliases. They must be qualified by optional coverage; never emitted or consumed as unqualified full-rule readiness.
approval_clarification.full_rule_ready_requires: All required core and applicable optional components READY with no conflict; mathematically valid measurements still confer no economic verdict.
approval_clarification.not_applicable_requires: Verified applicable policy exclusion, never absent data/policy; unknown classification remains POLICY_BLOCKED.

component_readiness_decision.example_scope: Contract examples, not production observations. A READY optional component presupposes its separately approved policy and verified inputs; these examples do not resolve the current POLICY_BLOCKED component contracts.

score_safety.optional_absence_policy: Surface optional coverage; no positive/default score fill, no weight renormalization or score re-averaging change without separately approved scoring policy.
score_safety.future_economic_states: Any later approved economic verdict requires a new exhaustive versioned mapping and calibration; unknown states remain fail-closed.

downstream_risks.risk: Rule31 risk mapping and Rule34 scenarios can accept unrecognized upstream labels unless a V2 adapter rejects them.
Required Rule33 inputs present but outside finite weak list can imply STRONG.
Unknown labels and PARTIAL can contribute positive values; available component averages can change without top-level weight changes.
Indirect version-incompatible score propagation could affect gate evidence.
Dossier coverage/lineage is not a positive family policy; existing N/A wording must not overwrite V2 policy-blocked semantics.
Version loss or partial-as-supportive promotion through rehydration and composition.
V1/V2 evidence/outcomes could be pooled without version labels or coverage denominators.

version_rehydration.v2_replay: Explicit caller-requested research replay with distinct versioned identity; original V1 receipt is never rewritten.
version_rehydration.runtime_effective_time: This timestamp-free documentation receipt is not a production effective-time registration. Future activation must bind authoritative approval/effective times; no historical backdating.

horizon_policy.future_requirement: An exact versioned V2 horizon/applicability reference with entity awareness is mandatory before horizon-aware V2 execution.
